title: Lava Once Shot 1,900 Feet in the Air in Hawaii

scenes.text: Lava once shot nineteen hundred feet into the air.
That's taller than the Empire State Building.
It happened in 1959, at Kilauea Iki in Hawaii.
Over five weeks, the volcano fired seventeen separate fountains.
The tallest is the highest lava fountain ever observed anywhere in the world.
Taller than a skyscraper, made of liquid rock.

description:
In 1959 the Kilauea Iki eruption in Hawaii sent a lava fountain 1,900 feet high, the tallest ever observed.
It erupted in 17 episodes over about five weeks.
Would you stand at the rim to watch?
first_comment: Lava fountain or geyser: which one would you rather watch?
